blocks.text: Incident: GA4 double-count after theme and app both fired purchase

This is the working cut for HBR-INC-2022-019 on March 8, 2022. Nia Brooks asked for a written bound after the current path (Theme pixel plus GTM, both on purchase) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host ga4.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on leave both pixels and filter in a report, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

One purchase event. Theme pixel off. GTM on. Deduplicate on transaction_id. Do not 'adjust' the GA4 UI by hand. I am not restating a hallway yes. leave both pixels and filter in a report is out because A report filter is not measurement. Nia would still brief the wrong number in a hallway. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at mult=1.96, hours=11, orders=34, extra=16.7, start=08:12, found=19:04, weeks=1, pixels=2. Sibling tickets HBR-2210 and HBR-INC-2022-019-GTM. I will not reopen leave both pixels and filter in a report in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
